title: Create multi-timescale memory structuring module chatbot/memory/timescale.py
description:
Create the module chatbot/memory/timescale.py to handle multi-timescale memory structuring. Define a classification system that categorizes retrieved memories into distinct timescales: recent conversational state, stable identity facts, long-term narrative arcs, and active goals.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/memory/timescale.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: define timescales using Enum or dataclass structs
add helper methods to categorize memory entries by age or metadata
forbidden: implement database retrieval logic in this module
